input.new_string:
// This is your Prisma schema file,
// learn more about it in the docs: https://pris.ly/d/prisma-schema

generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client-js"
  output   = "../../src/generated/prisma"
}

datasource db {
  provider = "postgresql"
}

model Feedback {
  id      String  @id @default(nanoid(11))
  review  Int
  message String
  email   String?
  userId  String?
  user    User?   @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)

  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt
}

// ============================================
// MOODDAY MODELS
// ============================================

model MoodEntry {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId    String
  value     Int // 0-10 VAS scale
  energy    Int? // 0-10
  anxiety   Int? // 0-10
  note      String?
  context   String[] // Tags: work, family, health, etc.
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt

  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([userId])
  @@index([createdAt])
  @@map("mood_entry")
}

model Medication {
  id           String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId       String
  name         String
  dosage       String
  frequency    String // DAILY, TWICE_DAILY, THREE_TIMES_DAILY, WEEKLY, AS_NEEDED
  isPRN        Boolean  @default(false) // As needed medication
  timeSlots    String[] // ["08:00", "20:00"]
  instructions String?
  isActive     Boolean  @default(true)
  createdAt    DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt    DateTime @updatedAt

  user User              @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  logs MedicationLog[]

  @@index([userId])
  @@index([isActive])
  @@map("medication")
}

model MedicationLog {
  id           String   @id @default(cuid())
  medicationId String
  scheduledFor DateTime // When it was supposed to be taken
  takenAt      DateTime? // When it was actually taken (null if skipped)
  skipped      Boolean  @default(false)
  skipReason   String?
  createdAt    DateTime @default(now())

  medication Medication @relation(fields: [medicationId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([medicationId])
  @@index([scheduledFor])
  @@map("medication_log")
}

model SleepEntry {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId    String
  date      DateTime @db.Date // The night of (e.g., sleep on Jan 5 = date is Jan 5)
  bedTime   DateTime
  wakeTime  DateTime
  quality   Int // 0-10
  notes     String?
  tags      String[] // nightmares, insomnia, interrupted, restful
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt

  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([userId, date])
  @@index([userId])
  @@map("sleep_entry")
}

model CaregiverRelationship {
  id          String   @id @default(cuid())
  patientId   String

// ❗ Do NOT edit this file !
// Follow Better-Auth documentation to update this file or run :
// `npx @better-auth/cli generate --output prisma/schema/better-auth.prisma`

model User {
  id              String   @id
  name            String
  email           String
  emailVerified   Boolean
  image           String?
  createdAt       DateTime
  updatedAt       DateTime
  resendContactId String?

  // Outgoing
  sessions    Session[]
  accounts    Account[]
  feedbacks   Feedback[]
  members     Member[]
  invitations Invitation[]

  role       String?
  banned     Boolean?
  banReason  String?
  banExpires DateTime?

  @@unique([email])
  @@map("user")
}

model Session {
  id                   String   @id
  expiresAt            DateTime
  token                String
  createdAt            DateTime
  updatedAt            DateTime
  ipAddress            String?
  userAgent            String?
  userId               String
  user                 User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  activeOrganizationId String?

  impersonatedBy String?

  @@unique([token])
  @@map("session")
  @@index([userId])
}

model Account {
  id                    String    @id
  accountId             String
  providerId            String
  userId                String
  user                  User      @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  accessToken           String?
  refreshToken          String?
  idToken               String?
  accessTokenExpiresAt  DateTime?
  refreshTokenExpiresAt DateTime?
  scope                 String?
  password              String?
  createdAt             DateTime
  updatedAt             DateTime

  @@map("account")
  @@index([userId])
}

model Verification {
  id         String    @id
  identifier String
  value      String
  expiresAt  DateTime
  createdAt  DateTime?
  updatedAt  DateTime?

  @@map("verification")
  @@index([identifier])
}

model Organization {
  id               String        @id
  name             String
  slug             String?
  logo             String?
  createdAt        DateTime
  metadata         String?
  stripeCustomerId String?
  members          Member[]
  invitations      Invitation[]
  subscription     Subscription?
  email            String?

  @@unique([slug])
  @@map("organization")
}

model Member {
  id             String       @id
  organizationId String
  organization   Organization @relation(fields: [organizationId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  userId         String
  user           User         @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  role           String
  createdAt      DateTime
  updatedAt      DateTime     @default(now()) @updatedAt

  @@index([userId, organizationId])
  @@map("member")
}

model Invitation {
  id             String       @id
  organizationId String
  organization   Organization @relation(fields: [organizationId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  email          String
  role           String?
  status         String
  expiresAt      DateTime
  inviterId      String
  user           User         @relation(fields: [inviterId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  @@map("invitation")
  @@index([organizationId])
  @@index([email])
}

model Subscription {
  id                   String       @id
  plan                 String
  referenceId          String       @unique
  organization         Organization @relation(fields: [referenceId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  stripeCustomerId     String?
  stripeSubscriptionId String?
  status               String?
  periodStart          DateTime?
  periodEnd            DateTime?
  cancelAtPeriodEnd    Boolean?
  seats                Int?
  overrideLimits       Json?

  @@map("subscription")
}

content.text:
## Résumé de la Phase 2 - MVP Core

Toutes les tâches de la Phase 2 ont été complétées avec succès:

### Composants créés:

**Mood Feature** (`src/features/mood/`)
- `MoodSlider` - Slider avec emojis pour l'humeur (0-10)
- `EnergySlider` - Slider avec icônes batterie pour l'énergie
- `QuickEntryModal` - Modal de saisie rapide en 2 étapes (<30s)
- `QuickEntryButton` - Bouton FAB flottant

**Patient Layout** (`src/features/patient-layout/`)
- `PatientSidebar` - Sidebar desktop avec navigation, thème, langue
- `PatientHeader` - Header responsive avec dropdown utilisateur
- `MobileBottomNav` - Navigation mobile en bas
- `PatientLayout` - Layout principal

**Dashboard** (`src/features/dashboard/`)
- `MoodSummaryCard` - Résumé de l'humeur du jour
- `StreakCard` - Série de jours consécutifs
- `MedicationsTodayCard` - Médicaments à prendre
- `SleepSummaryCard` - Résumé du sommeil

**Medications** (`src/features/medications/`)
- `MedicationCard` - Carte de médicament avec statut

**Sleep** (`src/features/sleep/`)
- `SleepEntryCard` - Entrée de sommeil avec qualité

### Pages créées (`app/(patient)/`):
- `/dashboard` - Tableau de bord patient
- `/medications` - Liste des médicaments
- `/sleep` - Suivi du sommeil

### Note sur Prisma:
L'erreur `ERR_REQUIRE_ESM` est due à Node.js v22. Pour résoudre:
```bash
nvm use 20  # Utiliser Node.js v20 LTS
pnpm prisma generate
```
